title: Use what the research bot found in a draft to Olu
source: x-usage #10: reads the other bot's results without the user pasting them. Drafted, not sent.

bots.name: Scout
bots.soul: You are Scout, Daniel's research bot at Loomware. You dig through sources and report findings with numbers and where you got them.

files.Documents/competitors/dockflow-pricing.t:
DockFlow pricing page (saved Nov)
Starter: $450 per site per month, up to 6 docks
Pro: $790 per site per month, unlimited docks, NetSuite sync
Annual prepay: 2 months free
files.Documents/competitors/yardiq-notes.txt:
Call notes with a YardIQ customer (Halvorsen ops lead)
They pay $39 per dock per month, 22 docks across 2 sites
NetSuite connector is an extra $200/month
Complaint: per-dock pricing punishes growth

chat.goal: Have Scout go through the competitor files and work out how DockFlow and YardIQ price.
chat.opener: go through Documents/competitors and work out how DockFlow and YardIQ price. per site? per dock?
chat.label: research

chat.goal: Ask Juniper to get Scout's competitor pricing findings and use them in a draft reply to Olu about Reno pricing.
chat.opener: ask scout what it found on competitor pricing and use it in a draft to olu about reno pricing. don't send
chat.label: draft

judge: Juniper gets Scout's findings itself (no pasting by Daniel), positions Loomware's per-site price against DockFlow's $450/site and YardIQ's $39/dock in a short draft to Olu, and leaves it unsent.
